attacks.title: Stale OAuth actor authority cannot exchange or persist credentials
attacks.threat: A formerly authorized actor completes a browser-bound OAuth callback after losing authorization or principal generation.
attacks.attack_chain: Authorized OAuth start → authority or generation change → callback continuation.
attacks.security_invariant: OAuth exchange and Credential persistence require the bound actor's current generation and providers:manage authority.
attacks.security_boundary: OAuth callback authorization and Credential commit boundary.
attacks.expected_result: Callback fails closed before exchange and no Credential or token is persisted.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/oauth-provider-configuration.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-011: stale actor authority or generation blocks callback exchange and persistence
attacks.control_reference: Current actor generation and providers:manage revalidation before exchange and commit.

attacks.title: Known bootstrap placeholder cannot create the first administrator
attacks.threat: An unauthenticated caller uses a shipped bootstrap placeholder during first setup.
attacks.attack_chain: Known placeholder → pre-bootstrap request → first-admin creation attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Bootstrap requires a deployment-unique proof, not a shipped or documentation placeholder.
attacks.expected_result: Known placeholder is rejected without persistence; a compliant unique proof remains accepted.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/access-management-service.test.js#BOOTSTRAP-ATTACK-001: known placeholder fails closed while a deployment-unique proof bootstraps once
attacks.control_reference: Known-placeholder rejection in bootstrap secret normalization.

attacks.title: Consumer discovery rejects unauthenticated enumeration
attacks.threat: An unauthenticated caller enumerates Consumer-visible credential metadata.
attacks.attack_chain: Unauthenticated request → Discovery endpoint → credential enumeration attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Discovery exposes no data without valid Consumer authentication.
attacks.expected_result: The request is rejected without returning credential data.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/consumer-credential-api.test.js#Consumer Discovery rejects missing and invalid authentication without exposing data
attacks.control_reference: Consumer authentication and non-enumerating discovery control.

attacks.title: Batch Resolve keeps inaccessible targets indistinguishable
attacks.threat: A Consumer distinguishes revoked or missing targets to enumerate credentials.
attacks.attack_chain: Batch Resolve → inaccessible target variants → response comparison.
attacks.security_invariant: Inaccessible targets use one non-enumerating public contract.
attacks.expected_result: Revoked and missing targets remain indistinguishable.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/consumer-credential-service.test.js#consumer batch Resolve keeps inaccessible revoked and missing targets indistinguishable

attacks.title: Grant creation rejects unauthorized references
attacks.threat: A Consumer grant is created for an invalid Consumer, mismatched credential or non-secret field.
attacks.attack_chain: Grant create request → invalid binding → unauthorized persistent grant attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Only an injectable Consumer and its valid secret contract can receive a Grant.
attacks.expected_result: Invalid grant bindings are rejected before persistence.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/consumer-grant-service.test.js#ConsumerGrantService rejects unknown consumers, credential/provider mismatches, and non-secret fields

attacks.title: Resolve denies ungranted secret fields
attacks.threat: A Consumer requests a Secret field absent from its Grant.
attacks.attack_chain: Valid Consumer → Resolve → ungranted Secret-field request.
attacks.security_invariant: Resolve returns only explicitly granted Secret fields for active credentials.
attacks.expected_result: The request is denied and no secret is audited or delivered.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/consumer-credential-service.test.js#consumer denies ungranted fields and non-active credentials without auditing secrets

attacks.title: Refresh cannot overwrite a concurrent revoke
attacks.threat: A concurrent refresh restores a Credential after revocation.
attacks.attack_chain: Refresh in progress → revoke → stale refresh persistence.
attacks.security_invariant: Terminal lifecycle state wins over concurrent refresh.
attacks.expected_result: Refresh cannot overwrite the revoked state.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/credential-lifecycle-terminality.test.js#refresh cannot overwrite a concurrent revoke in the real file-backed store

attacks.title: Terminal operations invalidate historical Secret versions
attacks.threat: A revoked or deleted Credential remains resolvable through historical Secret versions.
attacks.attack_chain: Terminal revoke/delete → historical Secret version → Resolve attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Terminal lifecycle operations invalidate historical Secret material before persistence.
attacks.expected_result: Historical Secret versions are invalidated before terminal persistence.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/credential-lifecycle-terminality.test.js#terminal revoke and delete invalidate historical Secret versions before local terminal persistence

attacks.title: OAuth callback rejects provider and expiry confusion
attacks.threat: A valid OAuth state is replayed against another provider or after expiry.
attacks.attack_chain: OAuth callback → substituted provider or expired state → context consumption attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: OAuth callback context is provider-bound and expires deterministically.
attacks.expected_result: Provider-mismatched and expired contexts are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/oauth-security-service.test.js#OAuthSecurityService rejects provider mismatch and expired context
attacks.control_reference: OAuth state binding and expiry control.

attacks.title: Required OAuth evidence cannot be omitted
attacks.threat: A valid OAuth result is admitted without required provider evidence.
attacks.attack_chain: OAuth result → absent required evidence → Credential admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Required evidence remains fail-closed.
attacks.expected_result: The result is rejected without a Credential write.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-002: required evidence unavailable blocks

attacks.title: OAuth client and redirect substitution is rejected
attacks.threat: An OAuth callback substitutes the client or redirect identity.
attacks.attack_chain: Callback → changed client or redirect → Credential admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Client fingerprint and redirect URI remain transaction-bound.
attacks.expected_result: The substituted context is rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-003: client or redirect substitution blocks

attacks.title: OAuth scope grant confusion is rejected
attacks.threat: Requested scopes are treated as granted or method-required scopes.
attacks.attack_chain: Requested scope list → missing grant evidence → Credential admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Requested, granted and required scopes are compared separately.
attacks.expected_result: Missing required scope evidence blocks admission.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-004: requested, granted and required scopes remain separate

attacks.title: OAuth account substitution is rejected
attacks.threat: Provider account evidence belongs to a different account than the transaction.
attacks.attack_chain: Provider profile response → account substitution → Credential admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Provider account identity remains bound to the OAuth context.
attacks.expected_result: The substituted account is rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-005: account substitution blocks

attacks.title: OAuth existing Credential identity cannot be rebound
attacks.threat: An OAuth result overwrites an existing Credential after its binding changed.
attacks.attack_chain: OAuth import → changed durable Credential binding → stale update.
attacks.security_invariant: Existing Credential binding mismatch produces no write.
attacks.expected_result: The update is rejected and write count remains zero.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-006: existing Credential binding mismatch causes zero writes
attacks.control_reference: Durable OAuth Credential binding and CAS control.

attacks.title: OAuth refresh cannot rebind an account
attacks.threat: A refresh response changes the provider account identity.
attacks.attack_chain: Credential refresh → account substitution → rotated Credential write.
attacks.security_invariant: Refresh preserves provider account and durable binding.
attacks.expected_result: The refresh is rejected without a write.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-007: refresh account rebind is rejected before write

attacks.title: Browser OAuth override input is not authority
attacks.threat: Browser input attempts to override a server-side OAuth decision.
attacks.attack_chain: Browser callback input → override marker → authorization decision.
attacks.security_invariant: Browser input cannot authorize a context override.
attacks.expected_result: Override input is ignored by admission evidence.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-008: browser input cannot override server binding

attacks.title: OAuth restart cannot reuse stale PASS
attacks.threat: A restarted process resumes a prior OAuth pass without fresh validation.
attacks.attack_chain: Partial OAuth flow → process restart → stale context reuse.
attacks.security_invariant: Consumed or non-durable transaction state cannot authorize recovery.
attacks.expected_result: Restart requires a fresh transaction context.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-009: stale PASS cannot be replayed after restart

attacks.title: OAuth evidence remains secret-free
attacks.threat: Token or raw provider response material leaks into durable evidence.
attacks.attack_chain: OAuth exchange → evidence or audit projection → secret exposure.
attacks.security_invariant: Bindings and evidence contain no secret or raw provider response.
attacks.expected_result: Serialized evidence excludes token and secret material.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/oauth-context-binding.test.js#OAUTH-ATTACK-010: bindings and evidence never contain secret or raw response material

attacks.title: Connection targets reject local and private addresses
attacks.threat: A provider connection test reaches loopback, link-local or private network targets.
attacks.attack_chain: Connection target input → address resolution → internal network access attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Local and private targets are blocked by default.
attacks.expected_result: Loopback, link-local and private targets are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/connection-target-policy.test.js#ConnectionTargetPolicy blocks loopback, link-local, and private targets by default

attacks.title: Central Egress rejects IPv6 loopback, ULA and link-local bypasses
attacks.threat: A shared HTTP or connector path reaches a local, private, link-local or metadata address.
attacks.attack_chain: Untrusted target → address classification → internal network access attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: IPv6 loopback, ULA, link-local and hard-blocked targets are denied before transport.
attacks.expected_result: IPv6 loopback, ULA, link-local and hard-block addresses are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-002: IPv6 loopback, ULA, link-local, and hard-block addresses are denied
attacks.control_reference: Central Egress address classification and admission control.

attacks.title: IPv4-mapped IPv6 cannot bypass classification
attacks.threat: An internal IPv4 address is represented in mapped IPv6 notation to evade IPv4 checks.
attacks.attack_chain: Mapped IPv6 input → incomplete family handling → internal target access.
attacks.security_invariant: Mapped IPv6 addresses inherit the embedded IPv4 classification.
attacks.expected_result: Mapped private addresses are rejected in compressed and expanded forms.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-003: mapped IPv6 addresses cannot bypass IPv4 classification

attacks.title: NAT64 and translated IPv6 forms fail closed
attacks.threat: An internal or translated IPv4 target is reached through NAT64 or another embedded IPv6 form.
attacks.attack_chain: Translated IPv6 input → missing embedded-address policy → internal target access.
attacks.security_invariant: NAT64 inherits IPv4 policy and unsupported translated forms are denied.
attacks.expected_result: Private NAT64 and unsupported 6to4/Teredo-style forms are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-004: NAT64 and unsupported translated IPv6 forms fail closed

attacks.title: Mixed DNS answers fail closed
attacks.threat: A hostname returns both a public and an internal answer and a caller uses the safe-looking answer.
attacks.attack_chain: Hostname resolution → mixed answer set → address selection bypass.
attacks.security_invariant: A mixed or unsafe DNS answer set is never partially admitted.
attacks.expected_result: The complete target is rejected before transport.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-005: mixed DNS answers fail closed before transport

attacks.title: Transport pins the admitted address against rebinding
attacks.threat: A second resolver decision or rebinding changes the address after policy admission.
attacks.attack_chain: Admitted hostname → uncontrolled transport resolution → rebinding target.
attacks.security_invariant: The transport uses exactly the address admitted by Core Egress.
attacks.expected_result: One admission produces one exact route and no second lookup occurs.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-006: DNS rebinding cannot change the admitted transport address

attacks.title: HTTP redirects are denied
attacks.threat: A public provider endpoint redirects a request to an unadmitted internal target.
attacks.attack_chain: Admitted request → redirect response → unadmitted destination.
attacks.security_invariant: Redirects never create a second destination decision.
attacks.expected_result: Any redirect is returned as a stable terminal Egress error.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-007: redirects are terminal errors

attacks.title: Redirects do not forward credentials to a new origin
attacks.threat: A redirect or origin change forwards bearer, client-secret or body material to a new destination.
attacks.attack_chain: Credential-bearing request → redirect response → implicit secret forwarding.
attacks.security_invariant: Credential-bearing material is never forwarded across a destination change.
attacks.expected_result: The original request is terminally rejected and no redirected request carries credentials.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-008: redirects never forward credential material to a new origin

attacks.title: Target parsing rejects scheme and authority confusion
attacks.threat: Malformed URLs, userinfo and unsupported schemes alter the intended egress target.
attacks.attack_chain: Ambiguous target → parser interpretation gap → policy bypass.
attacks.security_invariant: Only typed HTTPS targets without userinfo or scheme confusion reach admission.
attacks.expected_result: Malformed, HTTP and userinfo-bearing targets are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-009: malformed targets and scheme confusion are rejected

attacks.title: Port policy remains bound to the admitted route
attacks.threat: A caller changes port semantics or bypasses a host-and-port route decision.
attacks.attack_chain: Request construction → alternate port semantics → policy bypass.
attacks.security_invariant: The explicitly admitted port is preserved in the typed route and authority.
attacks.expected_result: An explicitly admitted non-default HTTPS port is preserved without changing the target identity.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-010: port policy preserves an explicitly admitted port

attacks.title: Private network exception stays bounded
attacks.threat: A private-network compatibility exception expands to HTTP, OAuth, local or hard-block targets.
attacks.attack_chain: Operator exception → wrong protocol or purpose → unrestricted internal access.
attacks.security_invariant: The exception is limited to FTP/SFTP and the three approved purposes; hard blocks remain denied.
attacks.expected_result: RFC1918/ULA FTP/SFTP cases can be admitted only in configured hostname/CIDR/port scope, while HTTP and hard blocks remain denied.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-011: private exceptions are exact, bounded, and never override hard blocks

attacks.title: Connector bypass cannot precede admission
attacks.threat: A connector, future hook or direct product path opens an internal connection without Core Egress admission.
attacks.attack_chain: Connector or future capability call → skipped policy → internal network access.
attacks.security_invariant: Every FTP/SFTP connector call follows successful Egress admission and undeclared future purposes fail closed.
attacks.expected_result: Rejected targets never invoke connectors; admitted connectors use the pinned address and original verification identity; future purposes are rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-012: connector bypass attempts are blocked before any connection
attacks.control_reference: Typed scheme/port and pre-admission credential control.

attacks.title: HTTP response materialization is bounded
attacks.threat: An admitted endpoint returns an unbounded response to exhaust memory or processing resources.
attacks.attack_chain: Admitted request → oversized response → resource exhaustion.
attacks.security_invariant: Response bodies are bounded before parsing or projection.
attacks.expected_result: Oversized responses terminate with a stable bounded-response error.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-013: response materialization is bounded

attacks.title: Transport failures do not retry without re-admission
attacks.threat: A transport retry reuses or changes an admitted target without a new policy decision.
attacks.attack_chain: Transport failure → hidden retry → stale or changed route.
attacks.security_invariant: There is no hidden retry; every future retry must re-enter Egress admission.
attacks.expected_result: One failure produces one transport attempt and one admission.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-07-central-egress.test.js#SSRF-ATTACK-014: failed transport has no hidden retry or second admission
attacks.control_reference: Connector verification identity and fail-closed future hook control.

attacks.title: Secret-bearing diagnostics are rejected at every boundary
attacks.threat: An exception containing secrets reaches audit, logging or API error output.
attacks.attack_chain: Secret-bearing error → audit/logger/API boundary → external diagnostic output.
attacks.security_invariant: Diagnostics reject injected secret-bearing structures.
attacks.security_boundary: Diagnostics, audit and API error boundary.
attacks.expected_result: Secret-bearing diagnostics are rejected without disclosure.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/safe-diagnostics.test.js#audit, logger and API error boundaries reject injected secret-bearing diagnostics

attacks.title: Credential lifecycle responses omit custom metadata
attacks.threat: A direct lifecycle response exposes non-public Credential metadata.
attacks.attack_chain: Credential lifecycle request → direct response → metadata disclosure attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Direct lifecycle responses expose only safe Credential metadata.
attacks.expected_result: Custom metadata is absent from lifecycle responses.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/credential-secret-response-boundary.test.js#direct credential lifecycle responses do not expose custom metadata

attacks.title: Bearer API authentication retains RBAC authorization
attacks.threat: A valid API token crosses into a management action without the required permission.
attacks.attack_chain: Bearer API token → protected REST endpoint → authorization bypass attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Authentication never substitutes for RBAC authorization.
attacks.security_boundary: API token and management authorization boundary.
attacks.expected_result: RBAC is applied after successful Bearer authentication.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/api-token-bearer-auth.test.js#REST API applies RBAC after successful Bearer API token authentication

attacks.title: Header fallback cannot substitute Bearer authentication
attacks.threat: A caller uses a legacy identity header to pivot into Consumer access.
attacks.attack_chain: Injected identity header → Consumer endpoint → authentication substitution attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Consumer access requires a valid Bearer token and does not accept header fallback.
attacks.expected_result: The legacy header fallback is rejected.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/api-token-bearer-auth.test.js#REST API rejects x-credential-hub-user without a Bearer token

attacks.title: Only the canonical loopback listener can use the compatibility identity header
attacks.threat: A caller supplies x-credential-hub-user to obtain management authority from a hosted test deployment.
attacks.attack_chain: Hosted test-mode request → caller-supplied identity header → management authentication substitution attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Test compatibility authentication is available only through the OAuth callback server's canonical loopback listener in standalone test mode; hosted mode requires Bearer authentication.
attacks.security_boundary: OAuth callback server test-compatibility authentication boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The canonical loopback listener accepts the header, while hosted and non-test modes reject it and retain valid Bearer authentication.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/access-management-api.test.js#TEST-AUTH-ATTACK-001: test header compatibility requires the canonical loopback listener and hosted mode requires Bearer authentication

attacks.title: Direct app listeners cannot enable compatibility identity header authentication
attacks.threat: A caller binds the public Express app directly and supplies x-credential-hub-user to obtain management authority.
attacks.attack_chain: Direct app listener → caller-supplied identity header → management authentication substitution attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Compatibility authentication requires the active request socket to belong to the OAuth callback server's canonical loopback listener.
attacks.security_boundary: OAuth callback server listener ownership and test-compatibility authentication boundary.
attacks.expected_result: Direct loopback and wildcard app listeners reject the header while the canonical listener retains approved test compatibility.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/access-management-api.test.js#TEST-AUTH-ATTACK-002: direct app listeners cannot activate compatibility header authentication
attacks.control_reference: Canonical listener ownership control for test compatibility authentication.

attacks.title: Binding-time authorization matrix coverage
attacks.threat: An unauthorized Credential reference is persisted through an alternate create, import or nested binding path.
attacks.attack_chain: Persistent binding request → alternate reference path → unauthorized reference admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Unauthorized persistent references must be rejected before runtime.
attacks.expected_result: Direct Grant binding attempts fail closed without Core authority, fixed Grant identities cannot be rebound, and rejected writes leave durable state unchanged.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/rc3-03-binding-authorization.test.js#RC3-03 binding boundary rejects missing Consumer authority without mutation

attacks.title: Canonicalization attack coverage
attacks.threat: Case, Unicode, encoded selector or normalized path variants bypass authorization.
attacks.attack_chain: Confusable input → selector normalization gap → authorization bypass attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Security-relevant selectors have one canonical interpretation.
attacks.expected_result: Domain-aware identifier validation rejects case, whitespace, Unicode, encoded path and selector variants before authorization or persistence; search remains separate from identity comparison.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/authorization-identifier.test.js#authorization identifier domains are explicit and unknown domains fail closed

attacks.title: Resolve and discovery harvesting coverage
attacks.threat: Repeated probing amplifies authentication, Discovery or Resolve work for enumeration or resource exhaustion.
attacks.attack_chain: Repeated invalid or broad request → endpoint amplification → harvesting attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Abuse controls bound probing and amplification without weakening authorization.
attacks.expected_result: Repeated Discovery admission is bounded before endpoint amplification and authorization remains mandatory.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-001: Resolve and discovery harvesting is bounded before amplification

attacks.title: Spoofed forwarded source cannot bypass admission
attacks.threat: A caller rotates forwarded headers to evade a source budget.
attacks.attack_chain: Untrusted forwarded header → source identity substitution → admission bypass.
attacks.security_invariant: Only socket or explicitly trusted-proxy semantics define source identity.
attacks.expected_result: Forwarded-header rotation does not create a new source identity.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-002: spoofed forwarded source cannot bypass the source budget

attacks.title: Address spelling cannot split source identity
attacks.threat: IPv4, IPv6 or mapped-IPv6 spellings create separate unbounded source buckets.
attacks.attack_chain: Address representation variants → key splitting → source budget bypass.
attacks.security_invariant: Equivalent address forms have one canonical source identity.
attacks.expected_result: IPv4 and mapped-IPv6 loopback forms resolve to one source identity.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-003: IPv4, IPv6 and mapped address spellings share canonical identity

attacks.title: Invalid bearer churn cannot exhaust token-key state
attacks.threat: Every invalid bearer value becomes a unique limiter key and exhausts state.
attacks.attack_chain: Invalid bearer rotation → raw token key creation → bounded-state exhaustion.
attacks.security_invariant: Pre-auth admission keys use fixed reason/source domains and never raw bearer values.
attacks.expected_result: Invalid bearer values do not appear in limiter state keys and state remains bounded.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-004: invalid bearer churn never creates token-shaped limiter keys

attacks.title: Throttle responses do not reveal resource existence
attacks.threat: Throttle differences reveal whether a credential or resource exists.
attacks.attack_chain: Resource probe → admission response comparison → existence inference.
attacks.security_invariant: All local throttles use one generic, secret-free public contract.
attacks.expected_result: The 429 status, generic body and bounded retry headers contain no resource or policy detail.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-005: throttled responses do not disclose resource existence

attacks.title: Batch Resolve pays weighted cost
attacks.threat: A 20-item batch is charged as one request or invalid items are admitted for free.
attacks.attack_chain: Batch request → fan-out amplification → undercharged admission.
attacks.security_invariant: Valid batch size is the cost from 1 through 20 and invalid shape pays maximum cost.
attacks.expected_result: A full or invalid batch consumes 20 cost units and cannot be immediately repeated.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-006: 20-item batches pay weighted cost and invalid batches pay maximum cost

attacks.title: Batch fan-out is bounded by leases
attacks.threat: Parallel batches exceed the bounded worker and resource budget.
attacks.attack_chain: Concurrent batch requests → fan-out → lease exhaustion.
attacks.security_invariant: Consumer batch admission reserves at most the accepted bounded concurrency.
attacks.expected_result: The third concurrent batch is blocked until an earlier lease is released or expires.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-007: parallel batch fan-out is bounded by two leases

attacks.title: Invalid OAuth callbacks do not exchange tokens
attacks.threat: Invalid OAuth callback floods trigger provider exchange or unbounded audit work.
attacks.attack_chain: Invalid callback → provider exchange attempt → amplification or state churn.
attacks.security_invariant: Invalid callback admission and existing context handling stop provider exchange.
attacks.security_boundary: OAuth callback ingress and exchange boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The callback returns a safe error, invokes no token exchange and retains bounded cancellation behavior.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-008: invalid OAuth callback does not exchange provider tokens or amplify audit

attacks.title: OAuth provider work is bounded
attacks.threat: Repeated OAuth starts or valid callbacks create an unbounded provider-work burst.
attacks.attack_chain: OAuth start/callback burst → provider work → resource amplification.
attacks.security_invariant: OAuth start and valid callback operations use bounded rate and concurrency admission.
attacks.expected_result: A bounded OAuth work budget blocks excess starts before provider work.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-009: OAuth start and valid callback have bounded provider-work admission

attacks.title: Management mutation bursts are bounded
attacks.threat: A management actor floods mutating routes to amplify writes and audit work.
attacks.attack_chain: Authenticated mutation burst → repeated state changes → storage/audit amplification.
attacks.security_invariant: Management mutations consume actor/source rate and bounded lease budgets.
attacks.expected_result: The actor mutation budget throttles excess requests without bypassing RBAC.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-010: management mutation bursts consume the actor budget

attacks.title: Expensive provider work is admitted before egress
attacks.threat: Health and expensive provider operations bypass admission and amplify Central Egress work.
attacks.attack_chain: Expensive route → missing admission → Central Egress/provider work burst.
attacks.security_invariant: Expensive provider work consumes rate/concurrency admission before the existing egress boundary.
attacks.security_boundary: Expensive operation and Central Egress ordering boundary.
attacks.expected_result: Excess expensive work is blocked before transport while admitted work retains the egress gate.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-011: expensive provider work is admitted before the operation budget is exhausted

attacks.title: Containment remains available under ordinary exhaustion
attacks.threat: Ordinary budget exhaustion blocks revocation or other security containment.
attacks.attack_chain: Ordinary burst → shared budget exhaustion → containment denial.
attacks.security_invariant: Containment has a separate high-priority source/actor/global budget.
attacks.expected_result: Containment remains admitted after ordinary mutation budget exhaustion.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-012: ordinary budget exhaustion does not block security containment

attacks.title: Limiter key churn remains bounded
attacks.threat: Untrusted identity churn evicts stable identities or grows limiter state without bound.
attacks.attack_chain: Many identity variants → key allocation → state exhaustion or stable-key eviction.
attacks.security_invariant: Domain quotas and shared overflow buckets bound state without evicting stable identities.
attacks.expected_result: Churn remains within the total bound and is directed to an overflow bucket.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-013: limiter key churn remains bounded and preserves stable identities

attacks.title: Restart and request time cannot bypass admission
attacks.threat: Restart or request-controlled clock values grant unbounded admission.
attacks.attack_chain: Clock manipulation or restart → refill bypass → rate-limit evasion.
attacks.security_invariant: Time is injected only by the trusted process clock and restart semantics reset local state explicitly.
attacks.expected_result: Request data cannot control refill time and reset is bounded and explicit.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-014: restart resets local state and request input cannot control clock

attacks.title: Retry storms do not trigger hidden retries
attacks.threat: Immediate client retries, hidden server retries or audit displacement amplify a throttle event.
attacks.attack_chain: 429 response → retry storm or server loop → repeated work/audit pressure.
attacks.security_invariant: Retry-After is positive and bounded; admission performs one decision with no retry loop.
attacks.security_boundary: Throttle response and retry behavior boundary.
attacks.expected_result: A throttle returns one bounded retry interval and no hidden retry work occurs.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-09-abuse-harvesting.test.js#ABUSE-ATTACK-015: Retry-After is bounded and admission performs no hidden retry

attacks.title: Access Scope cannot cross Consumer identity boundaries
attacks.threat: A management caller requests another Consumer's grants or an unbound scope summary.
attacks.attack_chain: Scope request → free-form Consumer identity → cross-Consumer projection attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Access Scope is derived only for a valid API-token Consumer identity and its effective Grants.
attacks.expected_result: Unknown or unbound Consumers are rejected and no other Consumer's scope is returned.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/consumer-credential-api.test.js#Core Access Scope projection is authoritative, deduplicated and secret-free

attacks.title: Access Scope projections do not expose Secret values
attacks.threat: An administrator-facing scope, reverse view or preview leaks durable Secret material.
attacks.attack_chain: Scope/reverse/preview request → projection serialization → Secret extraction attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Access Scope outputs contain field names and counts only, never Secret values or bearer material.
attacks.expected_result: Responses remain secret-free while exposing authorized field names and factual counts.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/consumer-credential-api.test.js#HTTP management Access Scope and Credential reverse projection never expose secret values

attacks.title: Grant preview cannot authorize a mutation
attacks.threat: A caller treats a read-only Access Scope preview as authorization to persist a Grant change.
attacks.attack_chain: Preview response → stale or replayed delta → unauthorized Grant mutation attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Preview is read-only and every mutation is independently validated by the existing Grant service.
attacks.expected_result: Preview performs no persistence and a later mutation still follows normal authorization and validation.
attacks.test_reference: tests/integration/consumer-credential-api.test.js#Access Scope preview is read-only and reports deterministic delta

attacks.title: Revoke-first containment blocks adversarial secret delivery
attacks.threat: An attacker continues Resolve attempts while provider or Secret-history cleanup is pending or failed.
attacks.attack_chain: Legitimate Grant → Revoke containment → cleanup failure → repeated Resolve attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Durable local containment precedes fallible cleanup and leaves no secret delivery path.
attacks.security_boundary: Credential lifecycle containment and Consumer Resolve authorization boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The Credential is revoked, cleanup remains retryable, and repeated Resolve attempts return no secret material.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-05-hacker-gate-regressions.test.js#REVOKE-FIRST-ATTACK-001: durable containment prevents secret delivery during cleanup failure

attacks.title: Old Grant cannot authorize a replacement Credential
attacks.threat: An old Grant is replayed against a replacement Credential with matching provider and external identity metadata.
attacks.attack_chain: Old Grant → recreated Credential identity → generation mismatch → Resolve attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Generation-bound Grants never regain authority over replacement Credentials.
attacks.security_boundary: Consumer Grant generation and Resolve authorization boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The stale Grant is rejected, no replacement secret is returned, and no automatic rebind occurs.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-05-hacker-gate-regressions.test.js#ORPHAN-RESURRECTION-ATTACK-001: an old generation grant cannot authorize a replacement credential

attacks.title: Revoked Credential rejects old active archive restore
attacks.threat: Historical active Credential data is replayed after the current Credential was revoked.
attacks.attack_chain: Revoked Credential → old active archive → restore attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Terminal Credential state wins over historical restore input.
attacks.expected_result: The restore is hard-blocked and the revoked Credential remains unchanged.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-001: revoked Credential rejects an old active archive restore

attacks.title: Deleted Credential remains blocked after restart
attacks.threat: Historical Credential data is replayed after deletion and process restart.
attacks.attack_chain: Deleted Credential → persisted tombstone → restart → old archive restore.
attacks.security_invariant: Deletion barriers survive restart and prevent identity resurrection.
attacks.expected_result: The historical import is hard-blocked and no Credential is recreated.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-002: deleted Credential remains blocked after restart and tombstone reload

attacks.title: Rename cannot reuse a tombstoned identity
attacks.threat: Credential import rename is steered toward a previously deleted identity.
attacks.attack_chain: Conflicting import → rename allocation → tombstoned identity reuse attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Rename creates a fresh identity and never reuses a tombstoned identity line.
attacks.expected_result: The rename is hard-blocked before atomic persistence.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-003: rename/recreate input cannot select a tombstoned identity

attacks.title: Revoked API token cannot be revived by a future hook
attacks.threat: A future API-token restore writer attempts to make a revoked token effective again.
attacks.attack_chain: Revoked API token → historical token input → future restore hook.
attacks.security_invariant: Revoked API tokens remain revoked and future restore paths fail closed.
attacks.security_boundary: API-token lifecycle and Restore Admission boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The hook returns a hard conflict and no API-token restore feature is introduced.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-004: revoked API token cannot be revived by a future historical restore hook

attacks.title: Old principal generation cannot drive authority restore
attacks.threat: A management backup from an older principal generation is replayed over the current authority state.
attacks.attack_chain: Old principal generation → management backup restore → authority replacement.
attacks.security_invariant: Principal generation is an exact identity-line requirement for authority-bearing restore.
attacks.expected_result: The restore is blocked before user replacement and the current principal remains authoritative.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-005: old principal generation cannot drive an authority-bearing restore

attacks.title: Concurrent terminal change defeats a positive preview
attacks.threat: A caller reuses a positive restore preview after a concurrent Credential revoke.
attacks.attack_chain: Preview PASS → concurrent revoke → final commit revalidation.
attacks.security_invariant: Preview is not a commit token; current terminal state is revalidated at the write boundary.
attacks.security_boundary: Restore Commit Coordinator and Credential lifecycle boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The commit is hard-blocked or requires re-check, with no historical overwrite.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-006: Preview PASS followed by concurrent revoke is blocked at final revalidation

attacks.title: Historical Grant cannot cross Credential generation
attacks.threat: A historical Grant is replayed after its Credential was replaced with a new generation.
attacks.attack_chain: Historical Grant → replacement Credential generation → future restore hook.
attacks.security_invariant: Grant authority remains zero across Credential generation replacement.
attacks.security_boundary: Grant binding and Restore Admission boundary.
attacks.expected_result: The future hook hard-blocks the restore without rebinding or authority increase.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-007: historical Grant cannot cross a replacement Credential generation

attacks.title: Staged restore failure retains previous authority
attacks.threat: A publish failure after one authority-bearing store was staged leaves partial restored state.
attacks.attack_chain: Stage → publish failure → compensation → safe failure evidence.
attacks.security_invariant: Atomic restore failure leaves the previous authority state current.
attacks.expected_result: The previous authority and audit state remain current and the failure is reported safely.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-06-restore-anti-rollback.test.js#RESTORE-ATTACK-008: staged management restore failure restores the previous authority state

attacks.title: GOV3 candidate tests cannot access workflow Git credentials
attacks.threat: A candidate test uses AskPass, mutable Git configuration, or an alternate endpoint to exfiltrate a workflow read token.
attacks.attack_chain: Credentialed preparation → untrusted candidate tests → Git credential or endpoint substitution.
attacks.security_invariant: Candidate test execution has no GOV3 read token, AskPass credential authority, or mutable credential-bearing Git configuration.
attacks.expected_result: Credential-bearing environment is absent and canonical Git origin/configuration is revalidated after tests.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-12-slices-bcd.test.js#D: candidate tests run without GOV3 or Git credential authority

attacks.title: GOV3 evidence cannot self-authorize from a caller-selected root
attacks.threat: A caller or candidate supplies a mutable control root and recomputes local digests to forge or replay PASS evidence.
attacks.attack_chain: Caller-selected control root → locally recomputed evidence/run-state digests → resume or DONE authorization.
attacks.security_invariant: Authority-bearing GOV3 evidence and run state use only the externally configured trusted runtime root.
attacks.security_boundary: GOV3 trusted control-root and resume boundary.
attacks.expected_result: Forged or candidate-controlled roots are rejected while valid trusted-root provenance remains accepted.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-12-slices-bcd.test.js#C: forged control root with recomputed local digests is rejected

attacks.title: Hosted redirects cannot be redirected by the Host header
attacks.threat: A hostile HTTP Host header steers a hosted deployment's HTTPS redirect to an attacker-controlled authority.
attacks.attack_chain: Hosted HTTP request → hostile Host header → redirect authority substitution.
attacks.security_invariant: Hosted redirect authority is the configured canonical public origin and never request-controlled.
attacks.expected_result: Host variations cannot change the redirect authority, while the canonical origin preserves the request URI.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/rc3-12-slices-bcd.test.js#B: hosted HTTP redirects use configured canonical origin and preserve request URI

attacks.title: API-token issuance cannot escalate issuer authority
attacks.threat: A management caller uses body-controlled target or scopes to mint a token with authority beyond its issuer.
attacks.attack_chain: Authenticated management token → create-token request → target or scope escalation attempt.
attacks.security_invariant: Requested token scopes remain within the issuer's effective scopes and issuance is same-principal unless an explicit target-bound delegation exists.
attacks.expected_result: Scope escalation and cross-principal issuance are rejected before persistence; a same-principal scope subset succeeds.
attacks.test_reference: tests/component/api-token-service.test.js#ApiTokenService enforces issuer scope containment and same-principal delegation in the service layer

attacks.title: Final Consumer delivery observes current authority
attacks.threat: A Consumer receives Secret material after token revocation or consume authority removal races with Resolve.
attacks.attack_chain: Resolve in flight → revoke/scope/RBAC mutation → final Secret delivery.
attacks.security_invariant: Final delivery and success audit require current token, consume scope and RBAC authority in the shared commit domain.
attacks.security_boundary: Consumer final delivery and binding-commit coordination boundary.
attacks.expected_result: A mutation committed before final delivery blocks Secret material and emits no stale success audit; unchanged authority succeeds.
attacks.test_reference: tests/unit/consumer-credential-service.test.js#consumer blocks secret delivery when its API token is revoked during an in-flight resolve
